title: Cut duplicate water reporting by farmers
action: Have Commonwealth agencies share water data they already collect, so irrigators and water operators report each piece of information once, as the interagency working group on Commonwealth water information found.
why: Irrigators report the same or similar water data to state and Commonwealth agencies in different formats, a cost with no benefit to water management.

evidence.quote: The Australian Government should implement the findings of the Interagency Working Group on Commonwealth Water Information Provision to reduce duplicative and unnecessary water management information requirements imposed on farm businesses.
